prompt: Use case: game texture asset. Create one high-quality hand-painted stylized RTS ground decal for a dark hollow-tree interior in Under the Canopy, an ant-scale fantasy strategy game. True transparent RGBA background, square composition, top-down orthographic surface-only albedo with even lighting, no perspective. A broad irregular connected island of damp olive-green moss, tiny rounded muted sage moss cushions, deep brown decayed wood fibers and fine pale ivory branching mycelium threads, with sparse small ochre shelf-fungus fragments and tiny chips of bark. Organic lobed silhouette with ragged porous edges and little detached satellite tufts, fading naturally to completely transparent pixels on all four sides. Keep middle also mottled with transparent holes so the authored underlying wood floor can show through. Quiet earthy desaturated palette, dark olive #3e492f, sage #677446, damp brown #493321, subdued ivory #b9b692; no saturated lime or cyan, no bright white. Broad readable forms and believable hand-painted surface texture, Warcraft-like game readability, more natural than flat vector shapes, not photoreal macro photography. No large mushrooms, no tall objects, no shadows, no glow, no labels, no text, no border, no checkerboard. The entire irregular bed stays inside the image with at least 6 percent fully transparent margin. This is a reusable terrain detail stamp, not a scene.
processing: Resize to 1024 square using Lanczos, preserving generated RGBA alpha; source retained unmodified.
